src: singleton marker pixels s ordered left-to-right when they share a row, or top-to-bottom when they share a column; plus the multi-pixel foreground template mask
dst: consecutive template-sized output slots d along the same row/column axis
transform: crop the template bbox; in each d stamp the template mask recolored to s.color, leaving non-mask cells as background
grid_shape: template bbox height by template bbox width times marker count; axis follows the marker row/column
